title: Binary Anchor Machine
statement: For every natural number $k$, define a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with a single state. Its initial state is the unique state, and every transition uses the fixed action requesting zero movement of the input head and the unique state as successor.
caveat: The meaning of the helper action `inputMoveAction` is not included in the supplied definitions, so the remaining components of its action cannot be stated precisely.
